title: Replication Package for "Process Mining and Stochastic Modeling for Software Process Forecasting: A Systematic Mapping Study with an LLM-Assisted Protocol"
description: Version 2 of the replication artefact for the IST round-1 revision. Systematic mapping study (not a systematic literature review) at the intersection of process mining, stochastic modeling, and machine-learning forecasting applied to software-development processes. Search: five databases (Scopus, IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, SpringerLink, Web of Science); eligibility window January 1994–December 2025; searches executed 12 April 2026. Confirmed set after cross-tier deduplication: 340 distinct primary studies (404 raw combined includes; 318-study analytical subset). Includes search strings; screening pipelines; LLM prompts (claude-haiku-4-5 primary, claude-sonnet-4-6 verifier); Dybå and Dingsøyr QA rubric; cross-model kappa; blind human double-screening and human–LLM kappa (T/A n=468, FT n=177); included_studies_340.csv; PRISMA; SEGRESS; EC5 audit; sensitivity analysis. PDFs of primary studies are not redistributed (copyright). Cite all versions: 10.5281/zenodo.20130275. This version: 10.5281/zenodo.21939471. Version 1 (10.5281/zenodo.20130276) is superseded.
